title: PythonInfo
description:
This defines the top-level object that describes the data returned by the server.
It contains information about each installation of Python that is known.

installations.description:
The array of information about Posit Connect's Python
installations.

api_enabled.description:
A `true` value is returned only when Python support is enabled in
Connect and API hosting is permitted by the product license. It will
be `false` in all other cases.

PyInstallation.description: This defines the information provided by the server about a single installation of Python.

version.description: The version number of this Python installation.

cluster_name.description:
The cluster that contains this Python installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the Python installation is local to the
Posit Connect server.

image_name.description:
The image that contains this Python installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the Python installation is local to the
Posit Connect server.
